$description: Kohbor dark semantic decisions v1.0.0. Design proposal under DEC-VISUALS; static verification does not certify native readability.

canvas.$description: Deep canvas behind navigation and panels.

raised.$description: Cards, bounded inspector and elevated regions.

hover.$description: Opaque hover surface for interactive rows.

selected.$description: Selected surface paired with accent text or selection mark.

overlay.$description: Opaque overlay text backing. Opacity/compositing needs native scene verification.

muted.$description: Tertiary body text; still meets intended normal-text contrast pairs.

disabled.$description: Readable disabled explanation; pair with explicit disabled semantics.

inverse.$description: Text on the designated light accent surfaces only.

accent.$description: Primary brand/action accent; never a claim of live health.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills.

default.$description: Decorative separators only; insufficient as the sole interactive boundary.

strong.$description: Interactive boundary on canvas/panel/raised; validate new adjacent backgrounds.

selected.$description: Selection boundary; always pair with text/icon/shape state.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring against opaque dark surfaces.

unknown.$description: Unknown has no observed value; use an explicit label or em dash.

stale.$description: Old observation; include age and stale text.

unavailable.$description: Unavailable capability; include reason and useful recovery action.

success.$description: Success emphasis; pair with icon and explicit text. Unknown must never use success reassurance.

success-surface.$description: Opaque success backing for the matching semantic foreground.

warning.$description: Warning emphasis; pair with icon and explicit text. Unknown must never use success reassurance.

warning-surface.$description: Opaque warning backing for the matching semantic foreground.

danger.$description: Danger emphasis; pair with icon and explicit text. Unknown must never use success reassurance.

danger-surface.$description: Opaque danger backing for the matching semantic foreground.

info.$description: Info emphasis; pair with icon and explicit text. Unknown must never use success reassurance.

info-surface.$description: Opaque info backing for the matching semantic foreground.

ui.$description: Thai-first UI family stack; no remote font requests.

supporting.$description: Authored UI font size; minimum 14px before stage fit.

offset.$description: 3px offset; reserve room so the outline is not clipped.

compact.$description: Proposed authored target. Native/DPI acceptance remains open.

reduced.$description: Reduced motion uses immediate presentation; state changes remain visible.

panel.$description: Optional visual elevation; outline remains available without shadow.
